🚨 Hiring: Senior Project Manager | Remote | EST Hours
We’re looking for a Senior Project Manager / Technical Delivery Manager with strong experience in Data, Analytics, BI, or Enterprise Reporting programs.
🔹 Hands-on Jira backlog & task management
🔹 Cross-team dependency & risk management
🔹 Technical delivery / data platform experience
🔹 Stakeholder & decision management
🔹 Experience working with Data/Analytics teams
🔹 FinOps / chargeback / cost allocation experience is a plus
📍 Remote – EST Hours
⏳ 3+ Month Contract

Interested? Please DM me or share your updated resume to guru.prasanth@vrproit.com.
